Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidders shall submit required documents towards fulfilling PQR criteria of the bid as below: Pre-Qualification Requirement (PQR) for Supply of Pressure Transmitters a) Pressure Transmitters 0 to 780 mmHg 15 Nos b) Pressure Transmitters 0 to 400 KSC 15 Nos 1 Bidder Status: The bidder shall be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of Pressure Transmitters o r an authorized dealer / distributor / channel partner of the OEM. In case the bidder is not the OEM, a valid and specific authorization certificate issued by the OEM for this tender shall be submitted along with the bi d. 2 OEM Experience: The OEM shall have a minimum five (5) years’ experience in the design and manufactu re of smart pressure transmitters with high precision suitable for Power plants (Thermal/gas/nuclear sets). 3 Past Supply Experience: The bidder / OEM shall have successfully supplied at least 10 nos of absolute an d Gauge type transmitters (smart) with accuracy of 0.075% of calibrated span during the preceding three ( 3) years as on the date of bid opening. 4 Documentary Evidence: To substantiate Clause-3 above, the bidder shall submit copies of Purchase Orde r(s) along with at least one documentary proof of supply such as Invoice / LR / Delivery Challan / Waybill / e-way bill against the same Purchase Order(s). 5 Relaxation for Start-ups: The past supply experience requirement stipulated at Clause-3 shall be relaxed for Start-up companies duly registered with the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (D PIIT), Government of India, in line with prevailing Government of India procurement guidelines. 6 Service/Repair: Servicing and Repairing should be available with vendor and Undertaking should be prov ided after sales. (up to 10 Years). Non-submission of documentary evidence as stipulated above shall render the bid liable for rejection. Evaluation of PQR shall be done on pass / fail basis only. 2. Financial Pre-Qualification Criteria: 1) The bidder shall have achieved the stipulated average annual financial turnover (Audited) during the las t three (3) completed Financial Years (FYs), i.e., 2023–24, 2024–25 and 2025–26, as specified below. a) For procurement of Pressure Transmitter 0 to 780 mmHG - 15 Nos - 5 lakhs b) For procurement of Pressure Transmitter (0 to 400 KSC)- 15 Nos - 4 lakhs 2) Bidder must not be admitted under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process or Liquidation as on date, b y NCLT or any adjudicating authority/authorities, and shall submit undertaking (Annexure1) to this effect. Explanatory Notes for the PQR: I. Bidder to submit Audited Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account for the respective years as indicated against Financial Turnover PQR – 1 & 2 above, along with all annexures. II. In case audited Financial Statements have not been submitted for all the three years as indicated agains t Financial Turnover PQR above, then the applicable audited statements submitted by the bidders against the requisite three years will be averaged for three years, i.e., total divided by three.

III. If Financial Statements are not required to be audited statutorily, then instead of audited Financial Stat ements, Financial Statements are required to be certified by a Chartered Accountant. 3. Kindly refer the attached ATC document for the Technical Specification for Pressure Transmitter. 4. Bidders shall submit duly filled & signed and stamped forms attached in ATC. NOTE - ALL POINTS OF TECHNICAL PQR, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS & CONDITIONS OF THE TENDER ARE TO BE COMPLIED, FAILING WHICH BIDDER OFFER IS LAIBLE FOR REJECTION. 5. Payment Terms: 100% payment will be released within number of days as given below from issue of consignee receipt-cum -acceptance certificate (CRAC) or Store receipt voucher. Sl Type of Bidder Payment terms (number of days) 1. MSE 45 days 2. Medium Enterp 60 days rise 3. Non-MSE 90 days 6. DOCUMENTS REQUIRED BEFORE/ WITH DISPATCH 1. Calibration Certificate 2. O&M Instruction 3. Test Certificate 4. Warrantee Certificate 7. For goods / works / services on Indian Suppliers / Contractors: Irrespective of the value of the invoice am ount, the supplier/ contractor should necessarily upload the invoice details on BHEL SUVIDHA portal at http s://suvidha.bhel.in/suvidha/, prior to dispatch/raising invoice. All documents as per contract checklist, alon g with additional documents (if any), must be uploaded on the portal. It is mandatory that tax invoices wit h a net amount (including taxes) exceeding Rs five lakhs uploaded on the portal are digitally signed using a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) issued by a licensed Certifying Authority. Submission of invoice document in hard copy is allowed for invoices with a net amount (including taxes) equal to and up to Rs fiv e lakhs in case the requirement for digitally signed invoice is not explicitly mentioned in the contract check list . The Invoice will not be accepted in absence of the above.” . 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
